0.0s–4.0s: <<<image_1>>> stands with her back to camera, copper curls and gown moving in the wind. The turn carries real weight: shoulders lead, hips follow, head arrives last; momentum settles as she completes the rotation. Thought process
Thought process
AJAX — super-caricatured Greek hero (anamorphic, no flares)
Cinematic character portrait, photorealistic but deliberately exaggerated and caricatured, 35mm anamorphic film still. A larger-than-life Greek hero, a super-caricatured macho beefcake — absurdly heroic proportions: enormous broad shoulders, a massive chest and chiseled six-pack abs, huge muscular arms, tiny waist. A powerful, jutting square jaw, perfect chin cleft, long flowing wavy golden-brown hair, piercing bright blue eyes, and an over-the-top cosmetically enhanced look — plump botox-pumped lips, suspiciously smooth filler-puffed glossy face, vain confident smolder. Bronze-gold Greek armor designed to leave the chest bare — open or harness-style cuirass, shoulder guards and bracers that frame but do NOT cover his huge oiled pecs and abs, red cape, leather pteruges.
